The phrase 'in half' does not justify its 10-foot answer.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02112","case1_error":"Omits the nine newly received fish from the total before halving, then arbitrarily rounds the resulting half-fish allocation.","case2_error":"Counts each win as one point rather than the specified two points.","reason":"Case 1 fails to update the inventory and rounds unnecessarily; case 2 fails to apply the stated scoring weight.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02113","case1_error":"Reports 200 pairs of plugs instead of converting to the requested 400 individual plugs.","case2_error":"Uses all 30 students as the last group’s size instead of subtracting the 25 students already assigned.","reason":"Case 1 answers in the wrong counting unit; case 2 uses the wrong population as the divisor.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02114","case1_error":"Doubles the second country’s duration for the third country instead of using the first country as the shared comparison baseline.","case2_error":"Converts six full days to hours using 16 rather than 24, leaving deliberation at six attendance days instead of nine.","reason":"Case 1 changes the comparison baseline; case 2 confuses full-day hours with daily deliberation hours.","judgment":"different"}]}
